podcast.body: Billy Idol's live version of this song, released on October 2, 1987, is renowned for an audience call-and-response chant that is extremely obscene. The audience responds to "here she comes now singing Moni Moni" with phrases such as "hey, mother F, get late, get F'd," a phenomenon that spread intercontinentally before the internet. "Billy's live version first appeared on October 2nd, 1987 long before there was an internet to propagate memes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
